settings.title: Why we exist
settings.text: Because getting dressed should feel like an act of self-expression, not an obligation. We exist for the woman who already knows who she is — she just needs the right piece to prove it.

settings.title: What makes us different
settings.text: We don't do seasons. We don't do markdowns. We don't restock. Every piece is released once, in a number small enough to feel intentional.

settings.title: The drop philosophy
settings.text: One drop per week. Every Sunday. A small edit of pieces built around a mood, not a trend. When the run is done, it's done.

settings.title: Made in small batches
settings.text: Small-batch production means every garment gets the attention it deserves. No shortcuts, no excess inventory, no waste — just pieces worth keeping.
